scope: Ordinary nonlegendary M21 black-border faces; preserve historical and alternate-frame mana, plus all inline symbols.
policy: Fresh M21 cards exclude all 72 printings in the earlier mana study. First four UUID-sorted cards per WUBRG rightmost symbol fit; remaining cards validate after settings freeze. The only unseen generic-only card is reserved for validation; numeral fitting also uses generic symbols on colored cards. Fixed 0.3.0 scan-frame transforms. No scan movement to fit symbols. Candidate changes never submitted as released scores.
limitations: Only one unused generic-only artifact remained; all numeral fitting uses generic costs on colored cards. No artifact-specific adjustment is fitted.
No claim for other sets, legendary crowns or special frames until checked separately.
Two reserved cards regress slightly in the whole-mana score; all are retained in the report.
